title: Notificable interface
description: Create an interface Notificable with enviar() and two classes that implement it.
solutionExplanation: The interface defines the contract; each class implements it in its own way.

title: Abstract class Animal
description: Create an abstract class Animal with an abstract method hacerSonido() and a concrete method dormir().
hints: abstract class Animal { abstract void hacerSonido(); }
dormir() has a body: System.out.println(nombre + " is sleeping")
solutionExplanation: Abstract class: shared code (nombre, dormir()) + contract (hacerSonido()).
expectedOutput:
Woof!
Meow!
Max is sleeping
Luna is sleeping

title: Payment system with interface and abstract class
description: Combine an abstract class and an interface: Pago (abstract) + Validable (interface).
hints: cobrar() uses instanceof Validable to validate
solutionExplanation: Combination: an abstract class for shared code + an interface for the validation contract.
